FEATURES.TITLE: Powerful Features
FEATURES.SUBTITLE: Everything you need for meaningful connections

REAL_TIME_TRANSLATION.TITLE: Real-Time Translation
REAL_TIME_TRANSLATION.DESCRIPTION: Break language barriers with automatic message translation. Chat with anyone worldwide in your native language.

SMART_MATCHING.TITLE: Smart Matching
SMART_MATCHING.DESCRIPTION: Our AI-powered algorithm matches you with people who share your interests and vibe for better conversations.

INSTANT_CONNECTION.TITLE: Instant Connection
INSTANT_CONNECTION.DESCRIPTION: Connect with someone new in seconds. No waiting, no algorithms - just pure spontaneous conversation.

PRIVACY_FIRST.TITLE: Privacy First
PRIVACY_FIRST.DESCRIPTION: Your conversations are encrypted and private. We don't store chat history or share your personal data.

INTEREST_TAGS.TITLE: Interest Tags
INTEREST_TAGS.DESCRIPTION: Add interest tags to your profile and get matched with people who share your hobbies and passions.

DARK_LIGHT_MODE.TITLE: Dark/Light Mode
DARK_LIGHT_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Choose your preferred theme with beautiful dark and light modes for comfortable chatting any time.

OUR_MISSION.TITLE: Our Mission
OUR_MISSION.DESCRIPTION: Chatme was created with a simple yet powerful vision: to connect people from all walks of life, regardless of language or location. We believe that meaningful conversations can happen anywhere, at any time, between anyone.

JOIN_OUR_COMMUNITY.TITLE: Join Our Community
JOIN_OUR_COMMUNITY.DESCRIPTION: Whether you're looking to practice a new language, make friends from around the world, or simply have interesting conversations with like-minded people, Chatme is here for you. Join thousands of users who are already breaking barriers and building connections.

WHAT_WE_DO.TITLE: What We Do
WHAT_WE_DO.DESCRIPTION: We provide a platform for spontaneous, real-time conversations with people around the world. Our smart matching algorithm connects you with individuals who share your interests, while our advanced translation technology ensures that language is never a barrier to connection.

CONNECTION.TITLE: 🤝 Connection
CONNECTION.DESCRIPTION: We believe in the power of human connection and authentic conversations.

INCLUSIVITY.TITLE: 🌍 Inclusivity
INCLUSIVITY.DESCRIPTION: Everyone deserves to be heard, regardless of where they're from or what language they speak.

PRIVACY.TITLE: 🔒 Privacy
PRIVACY.DESCRIPTION: Your privacy and security are our top priorities. We never share your data.

INNOVATION.TITLE: ✨ Innovation
INNOVATION.DESCRIPTION: We continuously improve our platform with cutting-edge technology and user feedback.
